decisions.reason: It is close to the established offer with less visible commitment, so it is somewhat easier to drop if results disappoint, but four years of persistence under escalation still favors keeping it.
As a product line with several models, it reflects greater investment and visible commitment, making management more likely to persist despite any disappointing results.
Its named launch and own website page signal public commitment, and the firm has kept it since 2018, so escalation of commitment supports keeping it.
